# Product launch

Announce, explain and celebrate what you build.

9 templates. Square brackets are placeholders: replace every one before you post.

## Product launch (`launch`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Announce something new: what it is, who it helps and where to get it.

```text
It is here: [product name].

[One sentence on what it does and who it is for.]

What you get:
• [benefit one]
• [benefit two]
• [benefit three]

[Where to get it, or a link]
```

## Feature announcement (`liFeature`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Skip the plain announcement. Show what the new feature makes possible.

```text
We just shipped [feature].

It took us [time], longer than we planned. The reason: [the part that turned out harder than it looked].

What you can do now: [what it makes possible].

What we learned building it: [one lesson].
```

## The plan we changed (`liBuiltWrong`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Share a decision you turned around. It shows you listen before you build.

```text
We were about to build [feature].

Then we talked to [number] customers. [What they told us].

So we built [what you built] instead.

What changed our mind: [the moment or the data].
```

## A request we said no to (`liSaidNo`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Explaining a no makes people trust your yes.

```text
A customer asked us for [feature] this week. We said no.

Not because it is a bad idea, but because [your reason].

What we are doing instead: [your alternative].

Would you have made the same call?
```

## A number we learned from (`liMetric`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: A real number says more than a vague claim about growth.

```text
[number] [customers, users or orders] [what happened] last month.

We looked at every single one. The main reason: [reason].

So this month we are [what you are changing].

I will share how it goes.
```

## Why I started this (`liOrigin`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Tell your origin story every few months. New followers have not heard it yet.

```text
[number] years ago I was [your situation].

I kept asking myself why nobody had built [the thing you missed].

So I started [company].

Today [where you are now]. What has not changed: [the reason you still do it].
```

## Customer story (`customerStory`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Let a customer tell, in their own words, what changed for them.

```text
“[A short quote from the customer.]”

[Customer name] came to us because [their problem]. With [product or service] they now [the result, with a number if you have one].

Thank you for trusting us, [first name].
[Link to the full story]
```

## Event reminder (`eventReminder`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Remind people of the date, the time and how to join.

```text
Save the date: [event name]

When: [day, date and time]
Where: [place or link]

[One line on what people get from it.]

[How to sign up, and by when]
```

## Milestone thank you (`milestone`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Mark a milestone and thank the people who got you there.

```text
We just reached [milestone].

That is thanks to you: [who helped, for example customers, readers or the team].

[One memory or lesson from the way here.]

Thank you. Next up: [what comes next].
```
